description:
A calmer desktop. Everything within reach.

Give every project a place. PecoFence organizes your Windows 11 and 10 desktop into fences: glass panels that keep your files close and give your wallpaper room to breathe.

LET YOUR AI SET IT UP
PecoFence includes pecofence-cli. Tell a coding agent such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor what you want in your own words: it reads your current setup and applies the changes, from new fences and sorting rules to icon sizes, colors and themes. Snapshots and configuration export keep a copy of a setup you like.

LESS TIME SORTING
Set rules for file types, names, age or size. New desktop files appear in the right fence automatically. Automatic sorting leaves their locations on disk unchanged.

YOUR FILES, ONE SHORTCUT AWAY
Press Ctrl + Alt + Space to bring your fences above the current app. Grab what you need, then press Esc to return.

FIND IT AS YOU TYPE
Start typing while your fences are in front, and a list shows the matching files and folders, Chinese names by pinyin included. If you like, the free Everything search adds results from the whole computer, and pressing Ctrl twice opens the search.

SMALL TOOLS WHEN YOU WANT THEM
Add notes with to-dos, a clock with the date, or a script fence that shows what your own script prints, such as the weather; its rows can open a link or tick a to-do when you click them. With Jump in file dialogs on, an Open or Save dialog goes to the folder you have open in File Explorer. Each tool stays off until you turn it on under Tools in Settings.

A SPACE FOR EVERY PROJECT
Combine related fences into tabs. Switch in a click, or drag a tab out into its own fence. Keep a live folder on the desktop and browse its subfolders in place.

MAKE ROOM FOR FOCUS
Double-click empty desktop space to hide your fences and again to bring them back. Roll a fence up to its title bar and hover to expand it.

GLASS THAT FITS YOUR DESKTOP
Choose Fluent or Liquid Glass, light or dark, then adjust each fence's color and opacity. Save your layout with snapshots and backups.

LIGHT ON YOUR PC
PecoFence is a native application that uses about 2 to 5 MB of memory at rest, as shown in Task Manager. The settings window loads only when you open it.

Free and open source under Apache 2.0. No app account required. Eleven built-in display languages, available offline. Designed for Windows 10 22H2 / Windows 11 x64.

PecoFence uses real files: file operations you initiate, including moves, renames and deletions, affect files on disk. Your normal Windows desktop icons return when the app exits.

releaseNotes: What's new in this update: you can edit a sorting rule where it stands. Each rule under Sorting rules has an Edit rule button that opens its name, its target fence and every condition; Save keeps the rule at its place in the list and leaves it on or off, Cancel changes nothing. A rule can have several conditions that must all hold: Add condition adds one, the cross beside a condition removes it, and Apply now moves the items that are already in fences. Fixes: the first right-click on a folder no longer freezes PecoFence on PCs with certain right-click menu extensions, such as Baidu Netdisk's; Start with Windows now turns autostart on and off in this Store edition; Delete and Ctrl+C react at once and also work on icons selected with a rectangle on the desktop; copy, cut and paste work in Peek at all fences; the fences no longer flash when they come back; Arrange like the desktop can be turned off from the right-click menu of an icon in the Desktop fence; and Space also previews in Seer.
